evidence.title: Choosing between Andheri West and East
evidence.property_name: Choosing between Andheri West and East
evidence.description: ## Variations in Property Andheri West is an older neighbourhood compared to Andheri East and has traditionally been a residential hub. Known for its upper‑class crowd, the area is home to film and TV stars as well as numerous film studios. The luxurious apartments overlooking the Arabian Sea are priced in many crores and feature modern amenities such as swimming pools, retail stores, multiplexes, and sports centres. With 2 BHK layouts and larger homes in high demand, property in Andheri West remains one of the most sought‑after choices for buyers. [...] ## Infrastructural Difference Andheri West offers stores from renowned brands and fine dining restaurants. It is an elite neighbourhood because of its proper infrastructure. It offers world-class academic institutions, healthcare facilities, and various commercial undertakings. It has excellent road and rail connectivity and is close to Mumbai's most prestigious neighborhoods. On the other hand, Andheri East ensures better connectivity because of its location advantage. It is near to the Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport. Additionally, the coming of the metro rail facility is another factor that drives the growth of real estate here. Its proximity to the Western and Eastern Express Highways also encourages people to buy homes in Andheri East. [...] ### What is special in Andheri? Andheri is the heart of the city of Mumbai. It has lots of commercial complexes and luxurious buildings. It is a great destination from both residential and commercial points of view. ### What is the difference between Andheri West and East? Andheri West is an already established locality making it a prime area with many facilities, whereas Andheri East is still developing, making it a good investment opportunity. ### Which part of Andheri has better connectivity? Andheri is a well-connected area, with all major public transport available. However, Andheri East is better connected to the rest of the city than Andheri West.
